robos:questLog.title: Departure from Candlekeep
robos:questLog.description: Gorion has urged you to make haste and purchase necessary supplies. Meet him by the central library steps once ready to leave.

stages.journalEntry: Gorion instructed me to prepare for an urgent departure from Candlekeep.
I have purchased supplies and travel rations from Winthrop's Inn.
I met Gorion at the library steps and we departed past the main gates.

objectives.text: Listen to Gorion's urgent warning at the library steps
Visit Winthrop at Candlekeep Inn and stock up on provisions
Meet Gorion at the library steps to depart

robos:questLog.title: Firebead's Identification Scroll
robos:questLog.description: Fetch the scroll of identify from Tethtoril and bring it to Firebead inside the Candlekeep Inn.

stages.journalEntry: Firebead Elfmirk asked me to fetch an identification scroll from Tethtoril.
I delivered the scroll to Firebead and received a protective ward.

objectives.text: Obtain identification scroll from Tethtoril in the gardens
Deliver scroll to Firebead in Candlekeep Inn

robos:questLog.title: Assassins in the Sanctuary
robos:questLog.description: Two cutthroats named Shank and Carbos have attempted to murder you in the storehouses. Find out who sent them.

stages.journalEntry: Assassins Shank and Carbos ambushed me within Candlekeep walls. I must eliminate the threat.
Both assassins have been slain and their bounties searched.

objectives.text: Defeat assassin Shank in the priest quarters
Defeat assassin Carbos in the bunkhouse

robos:questLog.title: Reevor's Infested Storehouse
robos:questLog.description: Clear out the giant rats invading Reevor's grain storehouse near the library.

stages.journalEntry: Reevor locked his storehouse due to giant rats and promised gold to clear them.
The storehouse has been cleared of vermin.

objectives.text: Exterminate giant rats in the grain storehouse
Collect reward from Reevor

robos:questLog.title: Dreppin's Sick Cow
robos:questLog.description: Retrieve an antidote potion from the temple stores to cure Nessa the cow.

stages.journalEntry: Dreppin asked me to fetch an antidote for his sick cow Nessa.

objectives.text: Fetch antidote from the healer temple
Administer antidote to Nessa the cow

robos:questLog.title: Hull's Longsword
robos:questLog.description: Find the longsword Hull forgot in the gate barracks and return it to him at the main gates.

stages.journalEntry: Hull left his longsword in the barracks and cannot stand watch without it.

objectives.text: Retrieve longsword from Hull's chest in the barracks
Deliver longsword to Hull at the main gate

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Awakening in Candlekeep
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Gorion summons his ward to the library steps with urgent warnings. Mysterious iron shortages grip the Coast and rumors spread of hunters seeking your blood.

robos:choices.label: Gather equipment and speak to Winthrop at the inn

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Preparations & Whispers
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Winthrop offers travel rations while Firebead and Hull share ominous warnings about cloaked strangers outside the monastery gates.

robos:choices.label: Search the bunkhouse and storehouse for supplies
Head directly to Gorion without lingering

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Sanctuary Ambush
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Two ruthless cutthroats corner you in the dark storehouse, seeking the assassin bounty on your head.

robos:choices.label: Defeat the cutthroats and recover the assassin bounty scroll

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Gates Close Behind
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Night descends as you meet Gorion at the gatehouse. The iron gates clang shut behind you forever as you step onto the Coast Way road.

robos:choices.label: Travel into the Lion's Way under cover of fog

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ambush on the Coast Way
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: A towering armored figure clad in spiked black steel and two ogres ambush your path, demanding that Gorion surrender the ward.

robos:choices.label: Refuse to abandon Gorion; unleash spells and stand your ground
Obey Gorion's desperate shout and flee into the dark forest

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Valorous Stand
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: You fight side by side with your mentor in a cataclysm of fire and steel against Sarevok's elite mercenaries.

robos:choices.label: Shatter the armored warlord's blade and preserve the Coast
Shield Gorion from the fatal blow, taking the dark spear yourself

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Orphan of the Wilds
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Gorion falls holding off the mercenaries. Rejoined by Imoen at dawn, you uncover the truth of your divine heritage.

robos:choices.label: Embrace the bloodline's dark power to claim absolute dominion
Succumb to despair without guidance, hunted in the wilderness

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending A: The Guardian of Candlekeep
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: The mercenary conspiracy is broken and the iron shortage ends.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: With Sarevok vanquished, your steadfast courage is celebrated throughout Baldur's Gate and Candlekeep. You forge your own destiny free of divine curse, remembered for generations as the Savior of the Sword Coast.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending B: Lord of the Iron Throne
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: You seize control of the Iron Throne syndicate and rule with an iron grip.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: Drawing upon the dormant divine spark within your blood, you crush both Sarevok and the Grand Dukes. The Iron Throne bends to your commands, and the Sword Coast enters a terrifying new epoch ruled by your merciless dominion.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending C: The Martyr's Sacrifice
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Gorion survives as you sacrifice your life to shield him from the killing blow.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: Though your physical journey ends here, your heroic selflessness shatters the dark prophecy. Gorion weeps upon the Coast Way stone and inters your remains in Candlekeep's sacred crypts, where eternal candles burn in honor of your soul.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending D: Consumed by Shadows
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: The shadows of the Sword Coast claim another unprepared soul.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: Overwhelmed by ruthless bounty hunters without Gorion's wise counsel, your tale ends in the brambled hollows of the Coast Way. The prophecy goes unfulfilled, waiting for another dawn.
